messages:
Aisha Khan: Quick sync — Acme onboarding has a renewal-risk flag. CS wants an SLO/SLA summary + last-30d compliance and a proposed credit calc before the renewal call tomorrow 11am PT.
Tom Becker: Which exact SLOs do we surface to the customer? contract lists uptime and latency but want the exact thresholds.
Aisha Khan: Contracted: uptime 99.9% monthly, latency p50 <= 120ms, p95 <= 450ms. Also note a region fallback 3 days ago that might affect uptime.
Jules Park: I can grab the metrics. Running export now. Command I'm using: `redwoodctl metrics export --customer acme --range 30d --granularity 1h --metrics uptime,p50,p95 --output acme_30d.csv`
Devon Li: FYI the fallback lasted ~18m on 2026-02-28 03:12 UTC — root cause was az failover, we had automatic routing to fallback model. Noted in incident #INC-20260228-03.
Olivia Ramos: For credits, the contract uses a stepped table (see section 4.2). Quick calc approach for draft: credits = floor((99.9 - uptime_actual)/0.1) * monthly_fee * 0.25. I'll confirm with billing.
Tom Becker: Export finished, uploaded CSV to #cs-artifacts (link) and to the shared drive. Quick snapshot: uptime over 30d = 99.82%, p50=110ms, p95=480ms.
Aisha Khan: That p95 is over the contractual 450ms cap — we need to show root cause and mitigation plan plus propose credit. Also customer wants a short one-pager SLO table they can include in their procurement doc.
Karan Patel: I can draft the one-pager. Suggest fields: SLO name, target, measured 30d, last incident note, mitigation. Will add a short how-we-measure blurb.
Olivia Ramos: Billing export in: billing-bot: `billing export acme 2026-02 --format csv` produced monthly_fee = $24,000. Using the draft formula, uptime deficit = 0.08 => floor(0.08/0.1)=0 => 0 credits by that simple floor. But contract table has a clause that p95 latency breaches can also trigger credits — need legal check.
Devon Li: We also saw a 2% spike in tail latency correlated with a model patch rollout 2026-02-20. Rollout notes: `deploy-bot: rollout v2.1 to us-west-2` — telemetry shows increased p95 for 24h.
Aisha Khan: OK action list: (1) @Jules Park finalize metrics export and attach to handoff doc; (2) @Karan Patel prepare customer-facing one-pager; (3) @Olivia Ramos confirm credit calc with billing/legal; (4) @Devon Li supply incident/rollout notes for root cause. I'll consolidate and send draft to account team by 10:30am PT.
Tom Becker: Noted, will pin CSV and add a 1-paragraph summary of measurement methodology.
Jules Park: Done — added CSV + `metrics-summary.md` to #cs-artifacts.
billing-bot: Billing export ready: https://billing.internal/redwood/acme/2026-02.csv
Aisha Khan: Thanks all. If we end up proposing credits, I'll include an explicit example table showing calculation and the fallback remediation timeline. Will request approval from legal if latency clause applies. See you on the 11am call. :thumbsup:
Karan Patel: I'll attend. Prepared to walk through the one-pager and timeline.
Olivia Ramos: Will follow up with billing/legal and post an update in this thread before 10:00am PT.
